blocks.html: Irie Vibes is a family festival. Children up to 14 years old get free entrance.
At the kids corner children can discover a magical world filled with toys, arts, games, suprises and entertainment.
Kids can enjoy the live bands or take their first steps on the dancefloor safely as childrens noise reducing headphones are available at the infostand for free (security deposit required).
Wristbands for lost kids are available at the entrance, the infostand and the kids corner.
Woven wristband for your kids are available on Saturday at the infostand
